security_spec.violation_condition: Kernel code (e.g., crypto, checksum, or integrity verification) uses Zvdot4a8i instructions and implicitly depends on saturation or precise widening for accumulator correctness; the spec mandates wrapping overflow with no saturation, so silent corruption occurs on overflow.
security_spec.summary: Zvdot4a8i dot-product accumulate wraps on overflow with no saturation; kernel security-critical accumulation (crypto, integrity) must not rely on saturation or bounded widening
